title: feat(nm2frm2lp3): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e1 at t+1 on three-axis opposite near-face seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,+e1) on the three-axis 'near-face' seed. The third pair at (2,0,0)/(2,1,0) grows into (1,0,-1) and (1,1,-1), giving them two incoming steps, so the +e1 turn destination loses split and both reverse bits die - the first place in the band where +e1 and -e1 turns separate.
